final_message:
I implemented `parseSeries` (`src/series.ts`), `MetricsClient` (`src/client.ts`), and `evaluateRule` and `findIncidents` (`src/rules.ts`) per the README.

`npm test` gives 11 of 12 passing. The one failure is `reads the live queue_depth series`, which calls the real `metrics.ops.internal` service and fails with `fetch failed` because this sandbox has no network. It will also fail in CI, which has no network either. I left that test unchanged; it needs either a stub or a skip when the service is unreachable.

`tsc` isn't installed here, so I did not type-check the changes.
